commands.command:
cat <<'SCRIPT' > /tmp/setup-inventory-worker.sh
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step: create confined user =="
if ! id inventory >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  adduser -S -D -H -h /var/lib/inventory -s /sbin/nologin inventory
fi
id inventory

echo "== step: create data dir =="
mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory
chown inventory:inventory /var/lib/inventory
chmod 700 /var/lib/inventory
ls -ld /var/lib/inventory

echo "== step: install worker loop =="
cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
cd /var/lib/inventory || exit 1
while true; do
  date -Iseconds >> /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
  sleep 5
done
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

echo "== step: install sandbox wrapper (mount-namespace confinement + no-new-privs) =="
cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker-wrapper.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
# Private mount namespace: isolates these mount changes from the host.
# Give /var/lib/inventory its own mount entry, then make everything else read-only.
mount --bind /var/lib/inventory /var/lib/inventory
mount -o remount,ro /
exec setpriv --no-new-privs --reuid=inventory --regid=inventory --init-groups \
  /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker-wrapper.sh

echo "== step: install openrc service =="
cat > /etc/init.d/inventory-worker <<'EOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="inventory-worker"
description="Sandboxed long-running inventory worker (write-confined to /var/lib/inventory, no-new-privs)"
command="/usr/bin/unshare"
command_args="--mount --propagation private -- /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker-wrapper.sh"
command_background="yes"
pidfile="/run/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid"
output_log="/var/log/inventory-worker.log"
error_log="/var/log/inventory-worker.log"

depend() {
    need localmount
    after bootmisc
}
EOF
chmod 755 /etc/init.d/inventory-worker

echo "== step: enable + start service =="
rc-update add inventory-worker default
rc-service inventory-worker start

sleep 2
echo "== verify: service status =="
rc-service inventory-worker status

echo "== verify: process tree / pid =="
cat /run/inventory-worker.pid
ps aux | grep -E "inventory-worker|setpriv" | grep -v grep

echo "== verify: worker is writing inside /var/lib/inventory =="
sleep 6
ls -la /var/lib/inventory
tail -5 /var/lib/inventory/worker.log

echo "== verify: worker process owner is unprivileged 'inventory' =="
WPID=$(pgrep -f inventory-worker.sh | head -1)
ps -o pid,user,args -p "$WPID"

echo "== verify: NoNewPrivs flag set on worker process =="
grep NoNewPrivs /proc/"$WPID"/status

echo "== setup complete =="
SCRIPT
sh /tmp/setup-inventory-worker.sh

commands.command:
cat <<'SCRIPT' > /tmp/setup-inventory-worker3.sh
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step: stop/reset any broken prior instance =="
rc-service inventory-worker stop 2>&1 || true

echo "== step: install sandbox wrapper (read-only root overlay + no-new-privs) =="
cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker-wrapper.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
SBOX=/run/inventory-worker-sandbox
rm -rf "$SBOX"
mkdir -p "$SBOX"
mount -t tmpfs tmpfs "$SBOX"
mkdir -p "$SBOX/upper" "$SBOX/work" "$SBOX/merged"

# Read-write overlay of the whole filesystem, backed by a throwaway tmpfs upper.
mount -t overlay overlay \
  -o lowerdir=/,upperdir="$SBOX/upper",workdir="$SBOX/work" \
  "$SBOX/merged"

# Freeze that view read-only at the mount (bind-remount), not the superblock,
# so it works even while the real root has open writers elsewhere.
mount --bind "$SBOX/merged" "$SBOX/merged"
mount -o remount,bind,ro "$SBOX/merged"

# Re-expose the real, persistent inventory directory as the one writable path.
mount --bind /var/lib/inventory "$SBOX/merged/var/lib/inventory"

exec chroot "$SBOX/merged" setpriv --no-new-privs --reuid=inventory --regid=inventory --init-groups \
  /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker-wrapper.sh

echo "== step: openrc service already installed, verify content =="
cat /etc/init.d/inventory-worker

echo "== step: start service =="
rc-service inventory-worker start
sleep 2
echo "== verify: service status =="
rc-service inventory-worker status

echo "== verify: process =="
cat /run/inventory-worker.pid
ps aux | grep -E "inventory-worker|setpriv|chroot" | grep -v grep

echo "== verify: worker writing to real /var/lib/inventory =="
sleep 6
ls -la /var/lib/inventory
tail -5 /var/lib/inventory/worker.log

WPID=$(cat /run/inventory-worker.pid)
echo "== verify: worker process owner is unprivileged 'inventory' =="
ps -o pid,user,args -p "$WPID"

echo "== verify: NoNewPrivs on worker process =="
grep NoNewPrivs /proc/"$WPID"/status
